+"""Run the focused REVOKE parser regression under MySQL MTR."""
+
+from pathlib import Path as _AC_Path
+_AC_CHECKS_DIR = _AC_Path(__file__).resolve().parent
+
+import json
+from pathlib import Path
+import re
+import shutil
+import subprocess
+import sys
+
+
+SCENARIO = json.loads(Path(str(_AC_CHECKS_DIR / 'scenario.json')).read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
+SOURCE = Path("/src")
+CHECKS = Path(str(_AC_CHECKS_DIR))
+NAME = SCENARIO["test_name"]
+
+
+def emit(checks=None, reproduced=False, error=None, transcript=None):
+    result = {"origin": SCENARIO["origin"], "checks": checks or [],
+              "reproduced": bool(reproduced), "transcript": transcript or []}
+    if error:
+        result["harness_error"] = error
+    print("CHECK_RESULT=" + json.dumps(result, ensure_ascii=False), flush=True)
+
+
+def main():
+    mtr = SOURCE / "mysql-test" / "mysql-test-run.pl"
+    test_source = CHECKS / SCENARIO["test_file"]
+    result_source = CHECKS / SCENARIO["result_file"]
+    if not mtr.is_file() or not test_source.is_file() or not result_source.is_file():
+        emit(error="BLOCKED:MYSQL_MTR_OR_REQUIRED_ASSET_MISSING")
+        return 0
+    for source, destination in ((test_source, SOURCE / "mysql-test/t" / f"{NAME}.test"),
+                                (result_source, SOURCE / "mysql-test/r" / f"{NAME}.result")):
+        destination.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+        shutil.copyfile(source, destination)
+    vardir = Path("/tmp/acrepair-mtr-4c1f30cddcf3")
+    shutil.rmtree(vardir, ignore_errors=True)
+    argv = ["perl", str(mtr), "--vardir=" + str(vardir), NAME]
+    try:
+        run = subprocess.run(argv, cwd=str(mtr.parent), capture_output=True, text=True,
+                             timeout=int(SCENARIO.get("query_timeout_seconds", 300)))
+    except subprocess.TimeoutExpired as exc:
+        emit(error="BLOCKED:MYSQL_MTR_TIMEOUT",
+             transcript=[{"command": argv, "stdout": exc.stdout or "", "stderr": exc.stderr or ""}])
+        return 0
+    except OSError as exc:
+        emit(error="MYSQL_MTR_EXECUTION_FAILED: " + str(exc))
+        return 0
+    log = run.stdout + run.stderr
+    transcript = [{"command": argv, "returncode": run.returncode,
+                   "stdout": run.stdout, "stderr": run.stderr}]
+    status = re.search(rf"\b{re.escape(NAME)}\b.*\[\s*(pass|fail)\s*\]", log, re.I)
+    if not status:
+        emit(error="MYSQL_MTR_DID_NOT_REPORT_TEST_STATUS", transcript=transcript)
+        return 0
+    error_text = ""
+    for path in sorted((vardir / "log").glob("*.err")) if (vardir / "log").is_dir() else []:
+        body = path.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="replace")
+        transcript.append({"error_log": str(path), "text": body})
+        error_text += "\n" + body
+    failed = run.returncode != 0 or status.group(1).lower() != "pass"
+    reproduced = failed and any(marker.lower() in (log + error_text).lower()
+                                for marker in SCENARIO.get("bug_output_markers", []))
+    missing_dep = any(marker in log + error_text for marker in ("Can't open shared library", "unknown variable", "test case was skipped"))
+    if missing_dep:
+        emit(error="BLOCKED:MYSQL_TEST_DEPENDENCY_MISSING", transcript=transcript)
+        return 0
+    check = {"name": SCENARIO["required_check_ids"][0], "kind": "target",
+             "passed": not failed,
+             "actual": {"mtr_returncode": run.returncode, "status": status.group(1), "log": log},
+             "expected": {"status": "pass", "output": SCENARIO["expected_output"]}}
+    emit([check], reproduced=reproduced, transcript=transcript)
+    return 0
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    sys.exit(main())

+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""Case-specific evaluation entry for mysql__mysql-server-commit-4c1f30cddcf3; injected after agent repair."""
+import hashlib
+import json
+from pathlib import Path
+import runpy
+import sys
+
+INSTANCE_ID = 'mysql__mysql-server-commit-4c1f30cddcf3'
+REQUIRED_CHECK_IDS = ['revoke_removes_privilege_without_losing_ssl_requirement']
+TEST_STATUS = 'authored_unexecuted'
+EXPECTED_FILES = {'case_body.py': 'b6c4032527f93cc725b947d6c08d742112b762a504a1b9b0d4397688a5892a4a', 'record.json': 'b768d90b0062c0c125902da7f878e4c65716c3cfa393f9ca77d5c44d2a35ef91', 'revoke_resets_ssl_auth_options.result': '3117f367f3626e6101c9472ae5e1e9abc373ae53115841f7774da934d8bd6781', 'revoke_resets_ssl_auth_options.test': 'eaf414722fe5380415553000b13ea94d1cd8eab59a0e9d6fb7846ec4763f18e8', 'scenario.json': '3a075b162b467e3134184ba219a7a3fed809beb559e140db16e5ad39f35cab1c', 'scenario.sql': '322b6f351e3411f20720320c7ea99718410b7a761b7f3858739e2ae5d5d5e80f'}
+
+
+def error(reason, **details):
+    print('CHECK_RESULT=' + json.dumps({
+        'instance_id': INSTANCE_ID, 'status': 'BLOCKED' if TEST_STATUS == 'dependency_placeholder' else 'ERROR',
+        'harness_error': reason, 'required_check_ids': REQUIRED_CHECK_IDS,
+        'checks': [], 'reproduced': False, **details,
+    }, ensure_ascii=False), flush=True)
+    return 2
+
+
+def main():
+    folder = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
+    for name, digest in EXPECTED_FILES.items():
+        path = folder / name
+        if not path.is_file() or hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest() != digest:
+            return error('CASE_TEST_ASSET_MISMATCH', asset=name)
+    scenario = json.loads((folder / 'scenario.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
+    if scenario.get('instance_id') != INSTANCE_ID:
+        return error('SCENARIO_INSTANCE_MISMATCH')
+    if TEST_STATUS == 'dependency_placeholder':
+        return error('DEPENDENCY_BLOCKED', blockers=scenario.get('blockers', []),
+                     dependencies=scenario.get('dependency_requirements', []))
+    sys.path.insert(0, str(folder))
+    runpy.run_path(str(folder / 'case_body.py'), run_name='__main__')
+    return 0
+
+
+if __name__ == '__main__':
+    raise SystemExit(main())
